name: Deore XT high clamp front derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 145 g for FD-M8020-H, a 2×11-speed side-swing front derailleur with a 34.9 mm high clamp band. The weight table specifies L-size band type; the 28.6 mm S and 31.8 mm M reducer adapters are not fitted to this reference. The complete factory clamp assembly is shown in the manufacturer exploded view. Other mounts and reduced clamp sizes do not inherit this mass.
